title: AI Deal & Regional Pricing Monitor input
description: Monitor official pricing and promotion pages for price drops, free trials, bundles, regional pricing, education offers, and device/app-store promotions.

startUrls.title: Pages to monitor
startUrls.description: Official pricing, promotion, help-center, app-store, or partner pages.

keywords.title: Deal keywords
keywords.description: Words or phrases that make a page change relevant.

includeBaseline.title: Output first-run baseline
includeBaseline.description: If false, the first run stores a baseline silently and later runs output only meaningful changes.

onlyMeaningfulChanges.title: Only output meaningful changes
onlyMeaningfulChanges.description: Require a keyword or price/currency match on changed pages.

webhookUrl.title: Optional n8n/webhook URL
webhookUrl.description: If supplied, meaningful findings are POSTed here after the crawl.
